subject.title: Feature: Support custom anthropic_beta flags in Bedrock model config

question: Should Bedrock expose a broad `additionalModelRequestFields` or `providerFields` passthrough, a narrower typed `anthropicBeta`/`context1m` option, or no user-configurable beta flags?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix creates a user-facing provider config contract on a compatibility-sensitive provider-routing surface.

options.title: Add Bedrock-owned request fields
options.body: Expose a Bedrock plugin or per-model params contract that safely merges validated request fields and covers `anthropic_beta` without making core config generic.

options.title: Add only a narrow beta flag
options.body: Support a typed Bedrock `anthropicBeta` or `context1m` path for Claude long context while avoiding a general Converse body passthrough.

options.title: Decline custom betas
options.body: Keep Bedrock request shaping internal and require first-class provider support for each beta feature before OpenClaw sends it.

recommendation.title: Add Bedrock-owned request fields
recommendation.body: Expose a Bedrock plugin or per-model params contract that safely merges validated request fields and covers `anthropic_beta` without making core config generic.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans provider/plugin boundary and config contract policy, and steipete merged the adjacent Anthropic GA migration cited in the issue discussion.
